heading: Things I've built
subheading: A few projects I've worked on. Click through to see the code or try them live.

projects.name: AniVerse
projects.description: An anime discovery and community app: trending and seasonal lists rendered with ISR, search with filters and infinite scroll, anime pages with SEO metadata, a personal watchlist with optimistic updates, reviews saved with Server Actions, and a live discussion powered by Supabase Realtime. Built on Supabase Auth, Postgres with Row Level Security and Storage, with Jest and Playwright tests.

projects.name: CoinPulse
projects.description: A crypto portfolio tracker with live prices for 2,000+ coins in a virtualized, infinitely scrolling table, price charts, a watchlist, and buy/sell tracking with profit and loss in USD or INR. Includes Firebase login with protected routes, React Hook Form + Zod validation, a responsive dark/light UI, and unit and component tests with CI.

projects.name: Ask Stream
projects.description: A ChatGPT-style Q&A app that streams Gemini answers token by token, with the streaming built by hand (no AI SDK): a Next.js route handler parses Server-Sent Events and the browser reads them with ReadableStream. Includes a Stop button with AbortController, automatic retry and backup models when the AI is busy, a live chunk timeline with time to first token, streaming-safe Markdown with code highlighting, rate limiting, and a dark/light UI.

projects.name: Penpot Bridge (POC)
projects.description: A proof-of-concept design-to-code CLI built at Opteamix that connects Penpot, the open-source design tool, to the codebase so designs can be turned into React components. I migrated the CLI from JavaScript to TypeScript, tested and improved its Penpot MCP setup so AI coding assistants can read design files directly, and worked on packaging it as a typed npm package for a private company registry.
